Package org.apache.hadoop.hdfs.qjournal.protocol

Interface QJournalProtocol

All Known Implementing Classes:
JournalNodeRpcServer, QJournalProtocolTranslatorPB
@Private public interface QJournalProtocol
Protocol used to communicate between QuorumJournalManager and each JournalNode. This is responsible for sending edits as well as coordinating recovery of the nodes.

    • heartbeat

      void heartbeat(RequestInfo reqInfo) throws IOException
      Heartbeat. This is a no-op on the server, except that it verifies that the caller is in fact still the active writer, and provides up-to-date information on the most recently committed txid.

    • startLogSegment

      void startLogSegment(RequestInfo reqInfo, long txid, int layoutVersion) throws IOException
      Start writing to a new log segment on the JournalNode. Before calling this, one should finalize the previous segment using finalizeLogSegment(RequestInfo, long, long).
      Parameters:
      txid - the first txid in the new log
      layoutVersion - the LayoutVersion of the new log
      Throws:
      IOException

    • finalizeLogSegment

      void finalizeLogSegment(RequestInfo reqInfo, long startTxId, long endTxId) throws IOException
      Finalize the given log segment on the JournalNode. The segment is expected to be in-progress and starting at the given startTxId.
      Parameters:
      startTxId - the starting transaction ID of the log
      endTxId - the expected last transaction in the given log
      Throws:
      IOException - if no such segment exists

    • getJournaledEdits

      QJournalProtocolProtos.GetJournaledEditsResponseProto getJournaledEdits(String jid, String nameServiceId, long sinceTxId, int maxTxns) throws IOException
      Fetch edit logs present in the Journal's in-memory cache of edits (JournaledEditsCache). To enable this cache, in-progress edit log tailing must be enabled via the "dfs.ha.tail-edits.in-progress" configuration key.
      Parameters:
      jid - The ID of the journal from which to fetch edits.
      nameServiceId - The ID of the namespace for which to fetch edits.
      sinceTxId - Fetch edits starting at this transaction ID
      maxTxns - Request at most this many transactions to be returned
      Returns:
      Response containing serialized edits to be loaded
      Throws:
      IOException - If there was an issue encountered while fetching edits from the cache, including a cache miss (cache does not contain the requested edits). The caller should then attempt to fetch the edits via the streaming mechanism (starting with getEditLogManifest(String, String, long, boolean)).
      See Also:
      • JournaledEditsCache
